{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the 'LOYAL' category exists
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"'loyal' category exists: {loyal_exists}")

# Check if there are any loyal customers who converted
loyal_converted = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['converted'] == 1)]
print(f"Number of loyal customers who converted: {len(loyal_converted)}")

# Calculate the fraction of loyal customers who converted
total_loyal = len(df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'])
converted_loyal = len(loyal_converted)
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / total_loyal

print(f"Total loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
